chunks: And from him (Al-Shaykh) from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Al-Qasim ibn Sulayman who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: "The grandfather shares with the siblings up to one-seventh."

key_terms.الْإِخْوَةَ: The siblings (brothers and sisters of the deceased)
key_terms.الْجَدُّ: The grandfather (specifically paternal in this context)

ai.seo_question: What is the share of the paternal grandfather when inheriting with siblings?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific share of the paternal grandfather (al-Jadd) when he inherits alongside the deceased's siblings, capping his portion at one-seventh (1/7). In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling is significant as it distinguishes the grandfather's status from that of the father, particularly in scenarios where the father is absent or deceased, ensuring equitable distribution among the siblings. The narration underscores the precision of the Imams in detailing inheritance shares to prevent disputes among heirs.
